policy: Use all24 existing role charts and48 independently validated face ports. An edge attachment is a retained PN face port whose geometric face contains that edge. A vertex attachment is defined analogously. Do not introduce scalar observations or demand a sector action be a geometric morphism.
test: Compute edge/vertex support and retained parent multiplicities, then all chart-pair geometric-identity domain inclusions. Exhibit the first lost edge and the exact absent face permits. Compare supported vertices with supported edges and retain higher-context unions separately.
boundary: This tests a single-chart attachment-domain projection. Failure of total identity-on-edge transport does not refute independent-context higher incidence. Support inclusion alone is not a native witness or a canonical map between multiple retained parent ports.
stop_condition: Exact finite coverage and inclusion classification, with source-bound lost-edge witness and explicit non-promotion boundaries.
